William Blake (1757–1827).  The Poetical Works.  1908.

On Friends and Foes

To F[laxman]: I mock thee not, though I by thee am mockèd

XI
I 
MOCK
 thee not, though I by thee am mockèd;
Thou call’st me madman, but I call thee blockhead.
